title: Archive folder
description: A warm paper folder opens into a small fan of weather prints.
useCase: Expose a small document collection while keeping its containing folder visible.
interaction: Open the folder and select a print.

assets.description: Shower Below the Summit (Sanka hakuu), from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjurokkei)"
Plum Garden at Kameido (Kameido Umeyashiki), from the series "One Hundred Famous Views of Edo (Meisho Edo hyakkei)"
Ejiri in Suruga Province (Sunshu Ejiri), from the series "Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjurokkei)"

reducedMotion: The cover and document fan change pose immediately.
limitations: Three local sample prints; file selection opens an inline preview and does not read the filesystem.
look: Mustard-gold paper folder with a darker back tab and the edge of cream prints peeking out, centred on a flat vermilion background.
motion: Clicking the front cover folds it 46° toward the viewer over 420 ms as three prints fan up and out with slight rotation over 480 ms, both strongly eased out.
adapt: The cover hinge is the `af-cover` `rotateX(-46deg)` transition (420 ms) keyed off `data-open`, and each `af-document` gets an inline fan `transform` from its index (86 px spread, 9° tilt, 480 ms). Replace `files` with your documents; keep `useCalm`.
